items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-24
items.q: such personalities as Edgar Guest and Guy Lombardo and Norman Rockwell were essentially the same, that they represented exactly the same point of view and appealed to the same people

ctx.x: Al, I'd like to ask you a question that interests me very much. What kind of a feeling do you get when you listen to, for instance, Big Spiderman solo? What kind of emotional fulfillment does that represent? What kind of people seem to be attracted to that kind of sound?

Well, I think that I understand the question. And, of course, as you understand, it's not my kind of people. That is, that I don't really respond emotionally to the Bix sound, although I understand it, I think. And I find it very interesting, but purely on an intellectual basis. But I don't have any visceral reaction to Bix. I feel that all of the arts, including music, is based on certain sound, on certain symbols that we are conditioned in such a way in our society so that we associate various symbols with…
